news.h: Patriots' TreVeyon Henderson affected by neurological symptoms
news.d: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson said tests have come back positive after he suffered "unexplained neurological symptoms" that remain "unknown and unexplainable."

news.h: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
news.d: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.
